concept: NavigationMenu is the row of section names printed along the top of a case. A name that holds more links is a key: press it and one plastic panel drops from it, the same panel Menu and Select open, printing the links in labelled groups. The page you are on is marked with an ink bar, and nothing in it is orange.

default_to_avoid.pattern: NavigationMenu as a mega menu that opens on hover with a full-width white sheet and a blue underline on the current link
default_to_avoid.why_not: Opening on hover cannot be done with a finger or a keyboard alone, and a blue underline tells the current page by colour while a wide white sheet breaks the unit's one light and its fixed layout.

default_to_avoid.pattern: site navigation of pill tabs with a filled accent background on the active item
default_to_avoid.why_not: A filled accent pill spends the unit's one orange on a label and reads as a pressed button, while a link to another page is printing and not a mechanism.

references.source: Braun T 1000 world receiver (Dieter Rams, 1963): band names printed along the case, with a lid that opens over the panel of the band you chose
WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices: disclosure navigation menu (https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/disclosure/examples/disclosure-navigation/)
system/FORM.md control class and surface class: printing on the inset line, and the plastic panel with elevation.float

derivation.form: The open panel is surface.solid plastic with elevation.float and corner.inner on layer.overlay, the same panel Menu and Select open and nothing deeper.

derivation.consequence: every part keeps ≥44px hit area even when it draws smaller
derivation.form: Every top name and every link in a panel is at least control.md tall and layout.touch wide, however small its words are printed.

derivation.consequence: every mechanism has its keyboard map
derivation.form: Left and Right arrows, Home and End walk the top names, Down opens a panel on its first link, arrows walk the links, and Escape closes the panel and returns focus to its name.

derivation.consequence: links, borders, icons, selections and charts never use it
derivation.form: The current page is told by an ink bar under its name and by weight, never by orange, and every link in the panel is plain ink.

derivation.consequence: no entry choreography, no idle animation; transitions only on state
derivation.form: A panel moves only when it opens or closes: it rises off its key on opening and sinks back faster on closing, and nothing else in the menu moves.

options.name: plastic panel dropped under its own key, groups side by side, the open key sunk into a well
one recessed band across the whole bar, groups in columns, the open name underlined
no popup: the names stack and the open one pushes the rest down with a dotted rail

variants.reason: A reuses the plastic panel of Menu and Select, so a person learns one popup, and it grows only as wide as its groups; B ties the panel's width to the bar and leaves a wide empty band when a name holds two links, and C pushes the rest of the page down each time a name opens, against P6 fixed positions where a unit's layout does not reflow between states.

root.why: The navigation is one landmark that takes the width of its row, so its names sit on the body's inset line like any other printing.

list.why: The top names stand in a single row that wraps when the unit is narrow, so a name never shrinks below a touch target.

item.why: Each name keeps its place in the row whether its panel is open or shut, and the panel hangs from it so the row does not reflow.

trigger.why: A top name, link or key, is a flat printed word at least 44px tall, so it can be pressed by a finger and it reads as printing on the case.

word.why: The name is printed in the label size of the one grotesk and stays on one line, so the row keeps its height.

mark.why: The current page is told by an ink bar under its name, a shape that survives without colour, and never by the orange.

chevron.why: A name that opens a panel prints a small chevron after its word, and the chevron points up when the panel is open so the state is a shape.

panel.why: The open panel is a plastic body with one short soft shadow on the overlay layer, the same panel as Menu and Select, hung from its key.

groups.why: The groups stand side by side in fixed columns inside the panel, so every choice is printed in plain sight and nothing reflows when focus moves.

group.why: One group holds a printed title and its links in one column, so the links that belong together stay together.

groupTitle.why: A group title is a small label in secondary ink, flat printing that names the column and is never pressed.

links.why: The links of one group stand in a list, one per row, so assistive tech reads how many there are in the group.

link.why: Each link row is at least 44px tall with its words inset from the rounded ends, so a finger can press it.

linkText.why: Link words use the body size of the one grotesk and stay on one line while the panel grows to the longest.

description.why: An optional line under a link's words is printed small in secondary ink so the word, not the line, is what is read first.

hover.why: A top name inks from secondary to primary when the pointer is over it, because a real key does not rise as a finger comes near.

aria-expanded=true.why: The name whose panel is open sinks into a small recess and its chevron points up, so the open state is depth and a shape, not a tint.

aria-current=page.why: The current page goes to primary ink in medium weight with the ink bar under it, announced with aria-current, and none of it is orange.

focus.why: The link under the keyboard or the pointer becomes a small recess, so the position is shown by depth instead of a tint.

focus-visible.why: When the keyboard moved focus, the name or link shows the same dark ring as every part, drawn so it is never cut by the panel's edge.

data-state=open.why: Opening is a state change, so it moves. The panel rises in from @starting-style over motion.release on the decelerating curve (D-008).

data-state=closing.why: While it leaves, the panel fades and sinks back over motion.exit on the accelerating curve, and no key or reader reaches it (D-008).

@media forced-colors: active.why: In forced colours the panel keeps a real border, the current page's bar draws in the text colour and the focused link uses the system highlight.

@media prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.why: Under Reduce motion nothing travels, so the panel does not rise; only fades remain, on motion.hover, which the tokens keep (D-008).

transform.why: Opening is a state change, so it moves. The panel rises off its key over motion.release on the decelerating curve and sinks back over motion.exit on the accelerating one (D-008). The chevron changes shape at once and does not turn.

opacity.why: Opening is a state change, so it moves. The panel fades in over motion.release and out over motion.exit, and under Reduce motion the fade is all that stays, on motion.hover.

color.why: A top name changes its ink on motion.hover, fast on and slower off, so a state change reads as one step and not a jump.

background-color.why: The reached link and the open name sink into a well on motion.hover, fast on and slower off, so moving down the panel reads as a walk, never a jump.

box-shadow.why: The reached link and the open name sink into a well on motion.hover, fast on and slower off, so moving down the panel reads as a walk, never a jump.
